topic: Room progress must accompany outgoing lane and exterior state

findings.evidence: Current version2 capture contains lane and exterior stage journals only; no room-progress component is retained.

Encoding uses private cleared+unreachable to interpret retired route nodes. The13-field journal carries positions, rosters, routes, lane states, pending, phase, entries and requests, but not cleared/unreachable/retryCounts/failedBy/deadline/lastProgressAt. ADOPT does not restore these six fields.

findings.boundary: room transition -> public durable order -> lane SAVE
findings.evidence: Room transitions mutate the private job arrays. Changed progress/retry publishes the14-field CBE_AIPass_ClearOrder at the room loop tail; lane SAVE occurs later at the callback tail. The terminal ClearEvidence write is separate. These are not one authenticated transfer envelope.

Resume obtains cleared/unreachable/retryCounts/failedBy/deadline/lastProgressAt from the previously delivered ClearOrder. Its missing lastProgressAt fallback is serverTime and mismatched failedBy length resets to per-room empty arrays. A future coherent replay path must validate original producer values before this legacy preparation can substitute defaults.

nextImplementation: Add one pure, bounded room-progress serializer from the actual private job, preserving original values and visitContext, and use it inside the existing fenced outgoing capture. Do not synthesize missing clocks or retry history.

Validate indices against the exact ordered positions, finite counts/clocks and bounded failure-lane identities. Refusal must remain distinguishable from a valid empty progress set. Preserve distinct physical visits and unreachable classification.

Do not admit the capture as incoming readiness. Full episode components, producer authentication, final seal/replay and actual actor/native acknowledgements remain required before replacing current resume transport.
